summary: Frontend-only test (mobile 390x844) of the 3 new features: (1) Radio custom URL, (2) editable Infornate table, (3) truncation notice / [[PLAN_END]] marker. All 3 features work. Radio: invalid URL -> alert and nothing saved; valid URL -> station in radio-custom-group, saved in localStorage mikilab_radio_custom, persists after panel close/reopen AND page reload, star adds to mikilab_radio_favs, remove button deletes from UI and localStorage. Plan generation (admin login, single recipe 30pz, single-phase, ~54s) completed: capo-plan present, NO '[[PLAN_END]]' in the rendered plan, NO false capo-plan-truncated banner. capo-infornate-editor rendered with 3 rows x 7 cols of editable inputs (capo-inf-cell-r-c); editing a cell persists in-session (survives scroll, add-row, delete-row); capo-inf-add-row 3->4 rows, capo-inf-del-3 back to 3 rows. No duplicated markdown infornate table inside capo-plan (body has no 'Orario Infornate' heading and 0 <table> elements outside the editor).

ui_bugs.issue: Cell values keep RAW markdown emphasis from the AI table: cell 0-0 = '**07:30**', vapore cells = '**Si** (pressione...)'. The editable inputs should strip **/*/`/ backticks when parsing the markdown table so the baker doesn't see/edit asterisks.

integration_issues.issue: Manual edits to the infornate table are session-only: after a page reload (plan restored from server) cell 0-0 reverts from the edited '05:45' back to '**07:30**'. Added/deleted rows are likewise lost. Also capo-share/capo-print send the original `plan` text, so shared/printed output does not include manual edits.

issues: Table needs horizontal scroll (expected on mobile) but column content is clipped mid-word (e.g. '40-45 mir', '**Si** (pr'); consider narrower columns or wrapping inputs

action_items: Strip markdown emphasis (** __ * `) when parsing the infornate table into the editable inputs (parseInfornate in PianoProduzioneAI.jsx).
Persist the edited infornate table (e.g. save infEdit in the plan state via capoPlanApi.save and re-hydrate on load) and use the edited table for share/print output.
critical_code_review_comments: PianoProduzioneAI.jsx is 1325 lines — split (plan form, modules, infornate editor) into modules.
useEffect([plan]) rebuilds infEdit from the plan text, discarding user edits any time plan changes (e.g. reload/restore) — intended state should be kept separately/persisted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional (2 non-blocking issues)

seed_data_creation: Temporary localStorage radio station 'Test Radio' created and removed during the test; a production plan was generated and saved for admin@mikilab.de.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radio custom-URL feature fully verified (validation, save, persistence, fav, remove). Infornate editor + PLAN_END/truncation verified with a single-phase plan (~54s generation, use 6s polling loop up to 3min). Remaining open items: markdown asterisks inside infornate input cells and non-persistence of manual edits after reload. Note: f-strings with escaped quotes break the Playwright runner — use string concatenation in selectors.
rca_of_the_issue: Both open issues stem from infEdit being a pure derived state of the markdown plan text: parseInfornate does not sanitize markdown emphasis, and the useEffect on [plan] resets infEdit on every plan (re)load, so manual edits are never stored server-side.
